what: PreCompact advisory message should be STRONG and focused on saving NOW — don't mention post-compact backup, create urgency. Message: "IMPORTANT: Context is about to be compacted and detail will be lost. Save key decisions via aide_remember RIGHT NOW while you have full context." Also: Claude Code debug log shows autocompact token usage (tokens=X threshold=Y) on every turn — could be parsed by Stop hook to detect when context is getting full and warn user to save. Fragile approach (debug log parsing) — better to file feature request for token usage in hook input JSON.
why: User wants strong pre-compact guidance, not passive mentions of backup. Also identified that autocompact threshold data exists in debug logs — potential for progressive warnings.
